name: corona
description: Corona: self-healing 3D spatial digital twin with a human-approved agentic AI swarm, temporal Graph-RAG, federated vision (ViT+CNN), post-quantum crypto and a tamper-evident audit ledger. Live demo + full Docker/Helm stack.

paragraphs: Built by Nikhil Chary Sriramoju · B.Tech CSE, Vaagdevi College of Engineering (2023–2027) · ML Engineer Intern @ Yuva Intern (NSDC) · Data Analytics Intern @ Thiranex · NASSCOM/Skill India Digital Hub (AI-Data Engineering & Cloud Infrastructure Analyst) · IBM SkillsBuild (AI Fundamentals) · Reliance Foundation (AI/ML Engineer Foundation) · LinkedIn
features: Human-approved agentic AI swarm (Validator → Compliance-RAG → Risk → Planner ⇄ Verifier → signed approval → Executor)
Zero-hallucination contract: no evidence → the swarm abstains; actions only from an allow-list with hard bounds
Tamper-evident audit ledger (SHA-256 hash chain, verify / tamper-test / export JSON)
Autopilot toggle for non-physical fixes; physical actions always need a signed human decision
Predictive failure forecast, federated-learning counter, copilot command bar
